ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 white-to-black pixel ratio with high macro-level contrast between the white lateral fields and the black central regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black pigmentation block radiating from the notch area into the interior of both lobes; scattered black focal spots (mottling) distributed across the white lateral fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 35-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks; significant irregular macro-serrations and jagged contours at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly concave trajectory along the trailing edge leading to elongated distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned dark linear disruptions (rake marks) observed on the white ventral surface of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Structural irregularity and possible tip truncation on the distal edge of the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical 'butterfly' pigmentation pattern centered on the median notch.
